defs.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
defs.genInstructions: Build a full left-hand deck: large spinning jog wheel with platter art, transport controls (play/pause, cue, sync), pitch/tempo fader, key lock, loop controls, hot cue pads, and a readout of loaded track title/BPM/key/time remaining. Serves as the primary playback engine for the left channel.
defs.role: The left playback deck that plays, cues, loops and tempo-adjusts one track and feeds its audio and position state to the mixer, waveforms and effects.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Track Library Browser
effectors.description: When the user double-clicks a track row or presses 'Load to A', the browser emits the track object (title, artist, BPM, key, duration, waveform data, audio URL); Deck A resets playhead to 0:00, loads the metadata readout, redraws the platter art and enters a paused/cued state.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
effectors.description: Dragging or clicking on Deck A's waveform lane emits a seek position in seconds; Deck A jumps its playhead to that position, preserving play/pause state.

targets.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
targets.description: Deck A continuously streams playhead time, BPM, tempo-adjusted playback rate, loop in/out markers, hot cue positions and play state; the display scrolls lane A accordingly and renders beat grid and markers.

targets.name: DJ Table: Mixer Console
targets.description: Deck A emits its post-tempo audio level and play state to mixer channel A, which applies channel gain, EQ, filter and fader before summing to master; the mixer's channel A VU meter reflects Deck A's signal.

targets.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
targets.description: Deck A sends its current BPM and beat phase so time-based effects (delay, beat echo, roll) assigned to channel A quantize their beat-division timing to Deck A's tempo.

defs.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
defs.genInstructions: Build the mirrored right-hand deck with the same capabilities as Deck A: jog wheel, transport, tempo fader, loops, hot cues and track metadata readout, acting as the playback engine for the right channel.
defs.role: The right playback deck that plays, cues, loops and tempo-adjusts a second track and feeds its audio and position state to the mixer, waveforms and effects for beatmatching against Deck A.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Track Library Browser
effectors.description: On 'Load to B' or double-click with deck B targeted, the browser emits the selected track object (title, artist, BPM, key, duration, waveform data, audio URL); Deck B resets its playhead, updates its readout and artwork and enters a cued state.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
effectors.description: Dragging or clicking on Deck B's waveform lane emits a seek position in seconds; Deck B moves its playhead there while keeping play/pause state.

targets.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
targets.description: Deck B streams playhead time, BPM, playback rate, loop region, hot cue markers and play state; lane B of the display scrolls and renders these markers, enabling visual beatmatch against lane A.

targets.name: DJ Table: Mixer Console
targets.description: Deck B emits its audio level and play state to mixer channel B, which applies gain, EQ, filter and channel fader before summing to master and drives channel B's VU meter.

targets.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
targets.description: Deck B sends current BPM and beat phase so beat-synced effects assigned to channel B quantize their divisions (1/4, 1/2, 1, 2 beats) to Deck B's tempo.

defs.name: DJ Table: Mixer Console
defs.genInstructions: Build the central mixer strip: two channel strips (trim/gain, 3-band EQ, filter knob, cue-headphone toggle, vertical channel fader, VU meter), a crossfader with curve selector, headphone cue mix/volume, and master gain. It sums both decks into the master output.
defs.role: The central summing hub that gains, EQs, filters and blends the two decks into the master signal that drives the master output section.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
effectors.description: Receives Deck A's live audio level and play state into channel A; channel A's VU meter animates from it and its fader/EQ/filter settings are applied to that signal.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
effectors.description: Receives Deck B's live audio level and play state into channel B; channel B's VU meter animates from it and its fader/EQ/filter settings are applied to that signal.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
effectors.description: The rack emits its wet/dry amount and assigned channel routing; the mixer inserts the processed signal into that channel's path, altering the level and tone summed to master.

targets.name: DJ Table: Master Output Panel
targets.description: On any change to channel faders, crossfader position, EQ, filter or master gain, the mixer emits the summed stereo master level plus per-channel contribution; the master panel updates its L/R meters, peak/clip indicators and master level readout.

targets.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
targets.description: Crossfader position and channel fader levels are emitted so the display dims or brightens the opacity/amplitude of each deck's waveform lane to reflect which deck is currently audible in the mix.

defs.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
defs.genInstructions: Build a wide stacked dual-lane scrolling waveform view above the decks with beat grid lines, playhead center line, loop regions, hot cue flags, zoom control and a full-track overview strip per deck. It provides visual beatmatching and scrub-seeking for both decks.
defs.role: The shared visual timeline that renders both decks' audio, beat grids and mix balance and lets the user scrub either deck to a precise position.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
effectors.description: Consumes Deck A's playhead time, BPM, playback rate, play state, loop region and cue markers to scroll lane A and draw its beat grid and markers in real time.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
effectors.description: Consumes Deck B's playhead time, BPM, playback rate, play state, loop region and cue markers to scroll lane B and draw its beat grid and markers in real time.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Mixer Console
effectors.description: Receives crossfader and channel fader values and adjusts each lane's opacity/highlight so the visually dominant waveform matches the audible deck.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
targets.description: Click or drag-scrub on lane A or its overview strip emits a target time in seconds; Deck A seeks its playhead to that time without changing play/pause state.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
targets.description: Click or drag-scrub on lane B or its overview strip emits a target time in seconds; Deck B seeks its playhead to that time without changing play/pause state.

defs.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
defs.genInstructions: Build a compact effects rack with selectable effect slots (echo, reverb, flanger, filter sweep, roll), per-slot on/off, depth and beat-division controls, a channel assign switch (A / B / Master), and an XY performance pad for wet/dry and parameter sweeps.
defs.role: The performance effects unit that processes a chosen channel's signal in tempo with the decks and injects the result into the mixer's signal path.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
effectors.description: Receives Deck A's BPM and beat phase so beat-division parameters for effects routed to channel A are quantized to Deck A's tempo.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
effectors.description: Receives Deck B's BPM and beat phase so beat-division parameters for effects routed to channel B are quantized to Deck B's tempo.

targets.name: DJ Table: Mixer Console
targets.description: On effect enable, depth/wet change or XY pad movement, emits the active effect type, wet amount and assigned channel (A/B/Master); the mixer inserts that processing into the chosen channel path, changing the level and tone it sums to master.

defs.name: DJ Table: Track Library Browser
defs.genInstructions: Build a bottom-spanning library browser: searchable, sortable table of tracks with title, artist, BPM, key, duration and rating, plus crate/playlist sidebar, filter chips for BPM/key/genre, and explicit 'Load to A' / 'Load to B' buttons. It is the source of tracks for both decks.
defs.role: The track source and search surface of the table, feeding selected tracks into either deck for playback.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
targets.description: Pressing 'Load to A' (or double-click with A targeted) emits the selected track's full object — title, artist, BPM, key, duration, waveform peaks, audio source — and Deck A loads it, resets to 0:00 and cues it.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
targets.description: Pressing 'Load to B' emits the selected track's full object; Deck B loads it, resets its playhead and cues it ready for mixing.

defs.name: DJ Table: Master Output Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a slim master output panel with stereo L/R VU meters, peak/clip indicators, numeric master dB readout, booth level knob, limiter toggle and a recording arm button with elapsed record time.
defs.role: The final monitoring section that visualizes and safeguards the summed master signal coming out of the mixer.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Mixer Console
effectors.description: Receives the summed stereo master level and per-channel contribution whenever faders, crossfader, EQ, filter or master gain change; updates L/R meters, lights clip indicators above 0 dB and refreshes the numeric dB readout.
